# YM27: 西峰秀色 Xifeng Xiuse, "The Elegant Color of the Western Peaks"

Malone calls it Hsi Feng Hsiu Se.

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM27` · Page: `/scenes/#YM27` · Row: `research/buildings/YM27-xifeng-xiuse/`

## What it was

西峰秀色 Xifeng Xiuse, south-west of 北远山村, a room on the river facing west to the Western Hills; across the river the pine-clad rock hill 小匡庐 Xiao Kuanglu with a 龙王庙 behind; east of it 含韵斋 Hanyun Zhai, then 一堂和气, and 自得轩 to the south-east; behind the wall 岚镜舫 Lanjing Fang east and 花港观鱼 west (S05 j82:6b; E1781). Of 1728 and Yongzheng's favourite residence (E1788, S361; S05 j82:8a note 皇考最愛居此); once with a stage for the Double Seventh; 含韵斋 five bays under three rolled roofs, 岚镜舫 twelve bays, 花港观鱼 a seven-bay hall over the river (E1788). Burned October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 雍正六年 1728 (S43); **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S08, S43, S01, S361).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Preface of 1744: "軒楹洞達面臨翠巘西山爽氣在我襟袖後宇為含韻齋周植玉蘭十餘本" (S05 j82:7a): an open hall facing the green hills, the clear air of the Western Hills in one's sleeves; behind it 含韵斋 among a dozen magnolias. The poem recalls ten years at his father's side here.

### The garden around it

Magnolias round 含韵斋 (S05 j82:7a; Malone ten to twenty, E1786); an artificial rock mountain 小匡庐 across the river, named after Mount Lu (S05 j82:6b); four boathouses east of the scene (E2391).
